# polaris_semantic_model (Data Source)

Fetches a Polaris semantic model. Requires the `ENABLE_SEMANTIC_MODELS` feature on the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_semantic_model" "revenue" {
  catalog   = "lakehouse"
  namespace = ["sales"]
  name      = "revenue"
}

output "revenue_metrics" {
  value = [for m in jsondecode(data.polaris_semantic_model.revenue.document).metrics : m.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The name of the catalog.
- `name` (String) The name of the semantic model.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace the semantic model is stored in, as an ordered list of levels.

### Read-Only

- `document` (String) The Ossie semantic model, a JSON object (use `jsonencode`). It must have a `datasets` array, and each dataset `source` must name an existing table or view of the catalog as `<namespace>.<table>`. Polaris stores it as written.
- `entity_version` (String) Opaque version of the semantic model, changed by every update and used for optimistic concurrency.
- `spec_version` (String) The Apache Ossie spec version the document follows, e.g. `0.2.0.dev0`.
